decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.5744. Series context: trend strength 0.8967 and seasonal strength 0.0898; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.517); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.86.
